svg.text: From intent to release with role subagents and six approval phrases. Antigravity hooks enforce the phrases; git keeps the record.
Then open a new conversation: hooks load at its start.
Then fill AGENTS.md, review plans/swarm.md, commit both yourself.
in a top-level conversation opened on the repository.
Every role runs as a subagent with its own context.
Type the approval phrases in this same conversation.
Resume any time with the same words: state lives in plans/.

A code owner merges; the swarm never pushes main.
Local hooks stop shortcuts; branch protection is the authority.
